scientific_preset.scope: Synthetic engineering demonstration; not biological or clinical validation

twin_body.scope: MuJoCo digital twin of the MaleCNS fly: meshless FlyBody body, 112 muscles, foot-space gait, closed loop connectome to muscles to body, noxious episode corpus

turning.mechanism: prescribed rigid rotation of the body and the foot frame
turning.why_prescribed: every stance claw is clamped to a fixed world point, so a body moment is absorbed as slip instead of turning the animal; measured with the moment applied on every substep, 0.002 to 0.04 dyne cm left both sides at 3-4 degrees (what an unsteered escape does) and 0.08 tore the feet loose
turning.not_in_default_features: the detection numbers in report 31 were measured before the turn existed
turning.limitation: the turn is prescribed, not produced by the connectome; a slip limit on the claws instead of a hard clamp is what would make it physical

corrections_from_measurement: reversing the phase instead of the stroke walks backwards but turns the animal -16.5 degrees in 600 ms, so the swing leg leads with the wrong pair
a pivot with a stride describes a 16.15 mm circle at -59.6 degrees; a pivot needs a zero stride
lifting a front leg in joint space does not lift the claw (nine femur and tibia poses moved it -0.0051 to 0.0000 cm); the lift is solved in foot space instead
a frightened animal must drop its programme: scaling a standing programme by the escape stride left it stationary (0.49 mm per escape) until the escape took the programme over (5.5 mm)
behaviours.limitation: all five programmes are prescribed; the connectome decides only whether to escape and which way, not which programme to run

gait.ceiling: the 0.08 cm stance clamp, not the stride: 0.32 cm at 0.09 s reaches 35.6 mm/s but the claw tears out (ik error 7.99 cm)
gait.defect_found: BehaviourLoop.__init__ kept a second copy of the constants (0.18/0.22/0.02) and passed them to FootGait explicitly, so retuning the module left the walk at 180 ms
gait.measurement_defect_found: the gait_final probe wrote body_yaw() (radians) into a field named turn_deg, so a 60.2 degree pivot read as 1.05 degrees; the episode converts with math.degrees, so section 10 stands
gait.back_why_slow: at a 90 ms period a full-rate reversal yaws 13.7 degrees in 600 ms and lifts the body to 0.0315 cm

twin_body.limit: the corpus uses a 120 ms window and 3 seeds; the gait displaces the body 0.31 to 1.56 mm in every episode including the zero dose, so displacement is not a label; no wings, no flight, no muscle antagonist pairs, 9 muscles have no motor neuron

verification.gpu_refined_synthetic: one refined synthetic cell, artificial event; not full population
verification.population_benchmark: 515.94 seconds, 166699 independent detailed cells, 10 ms model time, E1-REF; excludes network feedback
verification.population_feedback_full: 2379.93 seconds cold (was 4336.83) and 91.12 s warm for 166700 coupled cells: setup plus two cold passes of 1140.96 s and 1177.10 s, because an empty feedback schedule makes both iterations return the base receipt without a new replay; no threshold crossing at -300 nA and -20 mV, so the feedback effect is 0.0 uV
verification.narrowed_cell_cache_full: declared negative: building the entry cost a 1292.8 s pass and 38117519568 bytes, restoring from it cost a 1110 s pass against the 1140.96 s baseline (1.03x), because 38.1 GB of payload is read at about 35 MB/s in a live pass; it wins 1.31x on the widest 80 chunks only (131.05 s against 171.81 s) and stays switched off by default; 11 cache tests pass
verification.production_live: checked for the two-configuration stack on 23.11.2026: bash docker/build.sh --dev built aspa-dev-backend, aspa-dev-frontend, aspa-dev-celery-beat, aspa-dev-celery-worker-maintenance, aspa-dev-celery-worker-simulation, aspa-generator-gpu:dev and aspa-minio-source:RELEASE.2025-09-07T16-13-09Z, and bash docker/run.sh --dev brought up ten containers with backend, generator, minio, postgres, redis and mailpit healthy. GET http://localhost:8094/api/health returns 200, GET http://localhost:8095/ returns 200, the backend reaches http://generator:8090/health ({'status': 'ok', 'version': '0.1.16'}), nvidia-smi inside the generator container reports NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (6144 MiB, driver 621.14), numba.cuda.is_available() is True at compute capability (8, 6), and /geometry-cache/manifest.json is mounted read-only. The full coupled experiment itself was not re-run on this stack.
verification.two_compose_configurations: the stack is two files, docker/docker-compose.dev.yaml (aspa-dev, ten services) and docker/docker-compose.yaml (aspa-prod, nine services); the seven overlays and local_llm_bootstrap.sh are deleted and the generator is described identically in both with build.target gpu-runtime, gpus: all and an obligatory read-only geometry cache. The three env files are rewritten to one order of 125 keys in 14 sections with the sidecar leftovers removed, and scripts/check_env_contract.py (replacing two gates that were red by construction) checks that the example covers both configurations, that every key the code reads is declared, and that every GENERATOR_* key given to the container is referenced by the generator. Failures found by running rather than reading: the dev stack could not start because MinIO was pinned to an unavailable registry tag and is now built from ./minio, npm install in the frontend image diverged from the tracked lockfile so 102 of 258 suites could not load, the IDE harness variables were spelled with a single underscore so they never reached the backend, and the generator received GENERATOR_RADIUS_DB while contact_preflight.py reads GENERATOR_MORPHOLOGY_RADIUS_DB
verification.full_cns_gpu: coupled full population measured end to end but not validated biologically; the 300-second and 600-second targets are not confirmed; the fastest measured single full pass is 1027.96 s at 6.167 ms per cell after removing the redundant copies in _narrow and widening the recording window to 100 steps at a 2048 MiB output budget, which is 1.71x short of the 600-second target
verification.full_run_pause_resume: measured on slices: a checkpoint on a batch boundary resumes into the same event archive SHA-256 and the same signal as an uninterrupted pass, because batches are skipped only in the producer before the feedback schedule is applied; the request is a pause.requested file that survives a service restart; 5 of 5 pause tests, 8 of 8 execution tests and 1 of 1 HTTP test pass against /src. Confirmed on the full 166700-cell population (prod-h3/prod-h4): the pause was requested at about 215 s and taken on the 22nd batch boundary at 36079 cells, the checkpoint done_ids matched the archived cells exactly (0 differences), and the resumed pass reached 166700 cells in 1187.63 s with every archive byte identical to the uninterrupted prod-g run (initial-active 60cee23e, control 7c4ae747, signals 95376b52, coupled-source-events 8e188d69); only solver_kernels differs, 292 batches instead of 336, because the resumed pass does not re-solve the cells already recorded. Two real defects were found and fixed on the way: the controller latched its first answer so a request made after start was never seen, and the boundary was taken on a settled-but-streaming batch so the checkpoint published 23186 done ids against 21595 archived cells; 7 of 7 pause tests pass.
verification.full_control_omitted: a zero stimulus cannot depolarise a cell, so the control pass has no threshold crossings by construction; the measurement confirms it (control_max_uv 2.68e-09 uV against a 1.7175 uV peak, 168 archive rows for 166700 cells, 0 events, feedback_effect_uv 0.0). GENERATOR_FULL_CONTROL=omitted (the default) declares the zero line, writes the same empty-event control archive, keeps control_iterations and control_uv for the backend validator but marks them control_omitted with control_passes 0, and never caches the branch; 14 of 14 population feedback tests pass.
verification.wide_tail_flat_cache: declared negative: the selective flat narrow-cell cache reproduces every event digest bit for bit (identical_build and identical_cached both true) but a cached pass over the widest 80 chunks costs 171.45 s against 123.24 s plain, because 5.45 GB of payload is read at 178-204 MB/s while preparing and reducing those cells is cheaper; 7 cache tests pass and the cache is not wired into the production path
verification.store_volume_read: measured: the same bounded payload query answers at 975.6 MB/s from a container-local copy of source-geometry-v4-6um.sqlite against 14.2 MB/s through the Windows bind mount, a 69x difference, but a full pass with the database in a docker volume still cost 1147.65 s against 1027.96 s, because the 163 s of metadata reads overlap the producer rather than sitting on the critical path
verification.output_selection_table: declared partial: the compartments each cell must record are a function of its verified sources, the threshold and the distance cut, so they are stored once per preparation identity (malecns-output-selection-v1: 17736664 compartments, 73615936 bytes, 154.02 s to build) and read instead of planned; on the full population that moves the packer resolve from 355.03 s of a 1010.02 s pass to 204.35 s of a 921.52 s pass, against a 477.65 s ceiling when the packer does no durable work at all, and only 3 of 166700 cells ever report a candidate row, so the plan is built lazily for the cell that speaks; the table is published only for a complete non-resumed pass and refused on any other identity, threshold or damaged file; 9 new selection tests and 84 of 84 feedback tests pass. Not yet measured end to end: the production build (identity d05781bdfae88666d9f0e059cc523fcfc215b7e7bd77809ca0bcd5dc06f20979) was stopped on operator request before finishing, so 921.52 s comes from the probe, not from a coupled run.

nociception_operating_point.limits: No selectivity: the nearest foreign cable is 0.03 um away while the nearest afferent is 2.37 um, so 314 intrinsic and 24 motor cells cross too. The ascending answer is a LIF graph property, not HH with field. A threshold crossing is not a spike. 2.4 uA is the point where the model stops being silent, not a nociceptive stimulus for a fly.

nociception_behavioural_dose.limits: The label is the pair (stimulus site, current), not a cell. No cell in MaleCNS can be called a nociceptor on its own: a single afferent excites nobody, and equal-size bursts of md and chemosensory afferents recruit 11.8 against 11.4 ascending cells. Removal of all 26 md lowers the behavioural-dose response by 8 percent, so they modulate rather than drive. Motor spikes are measured, not muscle contraction: the graph has no muscle nodes, and the frontend motor readout covers 319 leg and wing motor neurons and none of the measured abdominal ones.

cable_screen.this_point: all four points free at 1.0 um

nociception_screened_point.limits: Selectivity costs current: 9.6 uA is 32x the -300 nA demo value and 152 non-afferent cells still reach 45 mV. A cable-free point is a geometry check, not electric isolation: a point-source field is not shielded by membranes. No afferent in MaleCNS carries a nociceptive receptorType, so these are abdominal afferents by position. A threshold crossing is not a spike.

nociception_address_map.claim: the nociceptive input is a dedicated address in the ascending layer, not a louder copy of the mechanosensory one
nociception_address_map.limit: above roughly 300 mechanosensory afferents the md-only block fires without any nociceptor present, so the address is observable only at small mass

recording_visibility.conclusion: the network is visible in the electrode record, but only differentially; the peak to peak of the whole trace is set by the stimulation artifact

differential.note: the address is not observable in absolute activity above roughly 300 mechanosensory afferents, but it is observable as a differential at every mass

boundary.note: two boundaries, not one; absolute observability ends at 300, the AN01A021 block stops separating at 500

nociception_second_wave.claim: the nociceptive path is a two-channel measurement: the electrode sees a field sum while the spike counter sees the population, and the motor threshold reproduces on a real pass

measurements.spike_channel_tests: 8/8 replay cache, 15/15 full population feedback, 5/5 windowed, 7/7 crossings, 7/7 pause, 5/5 frontend

code.spike_counter: window_crossings.py counts, population_windowed.py activity, replay_cache.py v2, full_population.py signals.npz + preview

nociception_second_wave.limit: the slice holds 60 of 307 abdominal motors, so absolute motor counts are not comparable with the full population; thresholds and curve shape are

nociception_full_population_curve.claim: the current -> spikes -> recording curve reproduces on the full 166 700-cell population, not only on a 6 255-cell slice
findings: the motor threshold is a property of the population, not of the slice
the ascending layer grows with current much faster than the motor layer (37 to 197 against 41 to 95)
descending neurons only answer en masse at -9600 (4 to 179)
brain cells stay at zero at both currents, so the giant fibre silence is not a slice artefact
98 % of the trace span is the stimulus itself; the network is 1.9 % of it
activity occupies 7-8 of 201 ticks: one short volley, not a sustained discharge
nociception_full_population_curve.limit: window is 10 ms instead of 100 ms because the long window exhausts the 8 GiB docker VM; the first motor appeared at 9 ms on the slice, so recruitment shares remain comparable

twin_calibration_and_validation.summary: Stimulus field reproduces three measured datasets exactly; the twin stands, walks and reacts under its shipped controller.

stimulus_field.note: The two measured datasets were taken at different thresholds; reading both at 7 mV left a 637-cell disagreement. The 120 um soma cap introduced to hide that is removed.

walking.note: Real Drosophila walk 10-30 mm/s, so the twin sits at the low end of the range.
